structured_simon_predictor.origin: new PyTorch parameter learner over the clean public symbolic SIMON cone; no archived runner, recovered key, old checkpoint or old solver import
structured_simon_predictor.learned_parameters: one initially random real logit per symbolic round-key effect coordinate; learned from TRAIN output-bit examples, not provided actual key material
structured_simon_predictor.permitted_prior: public round wiring and Boolean functions; parameter-identification interpretation is compatible with the prediction goal
structured_simon_predictor.no_secret_injection: model constructor accepts only rounds/target_bit; forward accepts only binary plaintext tensors; no cipher/data import or key_seed access
structured_simon_predictor.soft_model: deterministic sigmoid-leaf AND/XOR relaxation; not exact marginalization of correlated secret bits
structured_simon_predictor.hard_model: explicit thresholded parameter evaluation, separately reported; soft DEV BCE still selects checkpoint
structured_simon_predictor.key_schedule: independent effect coordinates, not constrained master-key recovery at rounds5+
structured_simon_predictor.validation_scope: small synthetic-key witnesses in tests only, one artificial unknown-XOR learning fixture, null-label CLI smoke; no new scientific cipher fitting or GPU results
